title: myosotis palustris var. laxiflora
intro: Myosotis palustris var. laxiflora, commonly known as marsh forget-me-not, is a variant of the myosotis palustris plant, a member of the borage family (Boraginaceae), characterized by its blue or white flowers and slender stems. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of marsh forget-me-not include sedation, anxiolytic effects, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
